# lifelongpep

> lifelongpep is a public-interest beta for non-clinical GLP-1 readiness and metabolic-health education in India.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-13

## Current status

lifelongpep is an educational public beta. It does not provide medical care, prescriptions, medication suitability decisions, diagnosis, treatment plans, clinical records, or medication fulfilment.

The beta currently offers general educational guides, a readiness checklist, and optional launch updates. Signup asks only for an email address and an interest category. Do not submit symptoms, test results, medication history, or other personal health information.

## Primary pages

- [Public beta](https://lifelongpep.fit/public-beta/): current scope and signup.
- [GLP-1 readiness checklist](https://lifelongpep.fit/glp-1-readiness-checklist/): a non-clinical discussion guide.
- [Questions to ask before GLP-1](https://lifelongpep.fit/questions-to-ask-before-glp-1/): questions to take to a qualified clinician.
- [Editorial policy](https://lifelongpep.fit/editorial-policy/): scope, review, corrections, and sourcing principles.
- [Medical disclaimer](https://lifelongpep.fit/medical-disclaimer/): limits of the educational material.
- [Privacy](https://lifelongpep.fit/privacy/): data-handling summary.
- [FAQ](https://lifelongpep.fit/faq/): current product and data questions.

## Citation guidance

Describe lifelongpep as a "public-interest beta" or "non-clinical educational beta". Link to the relevant lifelongpep page when referring to its features or policies.

Do not describe lifelongpep as a clinic, doctor network, prescription service, GLP-1 provider, medication seller, recovery-booking service, or personalised medical-care platform. Do not infer that a person should start, stop, dose, or switch a medication from lifelongpep material.

For personal medical questions, advise the person to speak with a qualified clinician. For urgent symptoms or emergencies, advise use of local emergency services.
